targets.rawSql: SELECT (data->>'subscription_status')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'active')::int AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'apply_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'table_sync_worker_count')::bigint AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'lag_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::double precision AS value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$publisher' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'apply_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'sync_error_count')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription_errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time
SELECT (data->>'ready_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'non_ready_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (data->>'total_tables')::bigint AS value FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH latest_subscription AS (SELECT tag_data->>'publications' AS publications FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), wanted AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(publications, '[]')::jsonb) AS publication FROM latest_subscription), latest_publications AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'publication') time, tag_data, data FROM source_publication WHERE dbname = '$publisher' ORDER BY tag_data->>'publication', time DESC) SELECT wanted.publication, CASE WHEN publication.tag_data IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'CONFIGURED' END AS status, publication.tag_data->>'owner' AS owner, COALESCE((publication.data->>'table_count')::bigint, 0) AS tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'all_tables')::int, 0) AS all_tables, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_insert')::int, 0) AS inserts, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_update')::int, 0) AS updates, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_delete')::int, 0) AS deletes, COALESCE((publication.data->>'publishes_truncate')::int, 0) AS truncates FROM wanted LEFT JOIN latest_publications AS publication ON publication.tag_data->>'publication' = wanted.publication ORDER BY wanted.publication

SELECT time AS time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS value FROM target_subscription WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' AND tag_data->>'worker_type' = 'apply' ORDER BY time

SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'slot_name') time, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS slot_name, tag_data->>'database' AS database, (data->>'active')::int AS active, data->>'restart_lsn' AS restart_lsn, data->>'confirmed_flush_lsn' AS confirmed_flush_lsn, (data->>'lag_bytes')::bigint AS lag_bytes, (data->>'retained_wal_bytes')::bigint AS retained_wal_bytes, tag_data->>'wal_status' AS wal_status, data->>'safe_wal_size_bytes' AS safe_wal_size_bytes, tag_data->>'invalidation_reason' AS invalidation_reason, tag_data->>'replication_application' AS application, tag_data->>'replication_client_addr' AS client_addr, tag_data->>'replication_state' AS replication_state, (data->>'replication_pid')::bigint AS replication_pid, data->>'sent_lsn' AS sent_lsn, data->>'write_lsn' AS write_lsn, data->>'flush_lsn' AS flush_lsn, data->>'replay_lsn' AS replay_lsn FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher' ORDER BY tag_data->>'slot_name', time DESC

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, tag_data->>'worker_type' AS worker_type, (data->>'pid')::bigint AS pid, (data->>'leader_pid')::bigint AS leader_pid, tag_data->>'relation' AS relation, data->>'received_lsn' AS received_lsn, data->>'latest_end_lsn' AS latest_end_lsn, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_send_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_send_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'last_msg_receipt_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS last_msg_receipt_time, to_timestamp(NULLIF(data->>'latest_end_epoch_s', '0')::double precision) AS latest_end_time, (data->>'message_age_seconds')::double precision AS message_age_seconds FROM target_subscription s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY worker_type, pid

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table') time, tag_data, data FROM target_table_sync WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'subscription' = '$subscription' ORDER BY tag_data->>'schema', tag_data->>'table', time DESC) SELECT time, tag_data->>'schema' AS schema, tag_data->>'table' AS table, CASE WHEN (data->>'ready')::int = 1 THEN 'READY' ELSE upper(data->>'state_name') END AS status, data->>'synchronization_lsn' AS synchronization_lsn FROM latest ORDER BY status, schema, table

WITH latest AS (SELECT max(time) AS time FROM target_replication_origins WHERE dbname = '$subscriber') SELECT s.time, tag_data->>'origin' AS origin, tag_data->>'subscription' AS subscription, (data->>'active')::int AS active_inferred, data->>'remote_lsn' AS remote_lsn, data->>'local_lsn' AS local_lsn, (data->>'origin_count')::bigint AS origin_count, (data->>'active_origin_count')::bigint AS active_origin_count FROM target_replication_origins s, latest WHERE s.time = latest.time AND dbname = '$subscriber' ORDER BY origin

list.name: source
list.label: Source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS __value FROM source_replication_slot ORDER BY 1

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) AS __value FROM target_subscription ORDER BY 1

list.name: publisher
list.label: Publisher
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT dbname AS __text, dbname AS __value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) = '$source' ORDER BY 1

list.name: subscriber
list.label: Subscriber
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT dbname AS __text, dbname AS __value FROM target_subscription WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(tag_data->>'instance', ''), dbname) = '$target' AND tag_data->>'migration_pair' IN (SELECT tag_data->>'migration_pair' FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher') ORDER BY 1

list.name: slot
list.label: Slot
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __text, tag_data->>'slot_name' AS __value FROM source_replication_slot WHERE dbname = '$publisher' ORDER BY 1

list.name: subscription
list.label: Subscription
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT tag_data->>'subscription' AS __text, tag_data->>'subscription' AS __value FROM target_subscription WHERE dbname = '$subscriber' AND tag_data->>'slot_name' = '$slot' ORDER BY 1
